name: TRAVEL-ONLINE-1-the-mod-the-player's
note: Travel Options off online would be fast travel - the teleport - for every trip.

name: TRAVEL-ONLINE-2-cautiously-the-player's
note: Cautiously's dial off online would teleport a cautious trip.

name: TRAVEL-ONLINE-3-inns-the-player's
note: Inns' dial off online would teleport a trip that stops at inns.

name: TRAVEL-ONLINE-4-the-wrong-reason
note: The locked travel switches would say a dungeon's monsters are the reason.

name: TRAVEL-ONLINE-5-the-ports-the-player's
note: AUDIT T1: the ports rule off online leaves the ship toggle on a wilderness trip inland - the teleport, free with Camp Out.

name: TRAVEL-ONLINE-6-no-floor
old: if (isOnlinePage() && !opts?.travelShip) { townTalk.say(ONLINE_LAND_TRAVEL_REFUSAL); hudFade.clearFade(); } else fastTravelTo(pick, opts, computed);
note: AUDIT T7: with the mod ever missing online, every trip over land would be the teleport.
